$comment: Per-flow protocol-load manifest for `roadmap measure` (ROADCODE 1659.3). Each entry lists a file the model LOADS into that flow's driving context, with a `why` naming the instruction site (skill:line) that causes the load — DERIVED from the post-1658 skills, never asserted. A renamed skill must break the meter (missing-path exit 1), never silently shrink it. Scoping rationale: DESIGN-NOTES.md §Measure scoping.

do-arc.note: The ORCHESTRATING session's loaded set. Subagent cards (phase-executor, reviewers, judges) load in FRESH subagent contexts and are excluded — covered by --flow do-phase. This is the set the arc's protocol-load-cut criterion measures against the ~49k baseline; the budget itself is PROTOCOL_LOAD_BUDGET_TOKENS in cli/lib/measure-budget.mjs.

files.why: using-zeroh-roadmap:3 — ALWAYS ACTIVE router, loaded every session
do-arc:40 — inline / inline-supervised bands run do-phase in the main session (arc-mode worst case)
do-arc:60 — sweep → run the arc-sweep skill in-session
arc-sweep:18 — 'Read skills/release-sweep/SKILL.md FIRST' (the debt vocabulary) — a genuine in-session load on the sweep leg
validate-arc:47 — read references/driving-tiers.md for the tier vocabulary
arc-sweep:44 + release-sweep Step 2.5 — the frontmatter grammar read when a sweep births or dispositions a followup (conditional load, the driving-tiers.md basis)

do-phase.note: The phase-executor SUBAGENT's own context (spawned fresh per phase). do-phase drives the loop; the executor card + its long-run reference load with it.

files.why: the executor's driving skill (do-phase for one phase)
the phase-executor agent card — the subagent's own instruction set

plan-arc.note: The planning session's loaded set: the design-first gate + the per-phase plan/review loop.

files.why: plan-arc:69 — the design-first gate contracts live in references/design-gate.md
design-gate:59 — the craft bar names references/ux-craft.md for a surface arc
plan-arc:12,59 — plans each member phase by looping plan-phase
plan-arc:12 — fans out plan-quality review (review-phase Mode A) across members

plan-arc:12 + plan-phase:12 + review-phase:12 — the `<root>/…` cite each planning skill opens with; writing a phase file's import (`../lib/schema`) and reading a root refusal are plan-arc acts, so the mechanics load here
